items.source_en:
[The Obsidian Refuge remains one of the galaxy’s most elusive legends—a tale of a forsaken outpost, hidden in the farthest reaches of the Outer Rim. Explorers, bounty hunters, and rogue scholars all speak of its haunting silence and the secrets buried within.]

Freedom. Bitter, fleeting freedom. The masked traveler stepped cautiously out of the refuge’s crumbling gateway, the faint glow of twin moons casting eerie shadows across the windswept plains. Dust swirled around them, caught in the dull hum of a nearby power generator sputtering back to life.

The energy locks sealing the refuge had failed—whether through tampering or simple decay, none could say. The air reeked of burnt circuitry and forgotten machinery, and the faint glimmer of a distant freighter pierced the endless night sky.

"And now," the traveler muttered, their voice filtered through the static of a damaged comm unit, "I will leave this place behind, and let the galaxy reckon with what I have found."

[옵시디언 피난처는 은하계에서 가장 찾기 힘든 전설 중 하나로 남아 있다. 아우터 림의 가장 먼 곳에 숨겨진 버려진 전초기지에 관한 이야기다. 탐험가, 현상금 임무 수행자, 그리고 떠돌이 학자들은 모두 그곳의 으스스한 정적과 그 안에 묻힌 비밀에 대해 이야기한다.]

자유. 쓰디쓰고 덧없는 자유. 가면을 쓴 여행자가 피난처의 무너져가는 관문 밖으로 조심스럽게 발을 내디뎠다. 쌍둥이 달의 희미한 빛이 바람 부는 평원 위로 기괴한 그림자를 드리웠다. 먼지가 소용돌이쳤고, 근처에서 다시 가동되기 시작한 발전기의 둔탁한 웅웅거림이 들려왔다.

피난처를 봉인하던 에너지 잠금장치는 고장 나 있었다. 누군가 손을 댄 것인지, 아니면 단순히 노후화된 것인지 알 수 없었다. 공기 중에는 타버린 회로와 잊힌 기계 냄새가 진동했고, 끝없는 밤하늘 너머로 멀리 떨어진 화물선의 희미한 불빛이 보였다.

"이제," 여행자가 중얼거렸다. 그 목소리는 손상된 통신 장치의 잡음 섞인 필터를 거쳐 흘러나왔다. "이곳을 뒤로하고, 내가 발견한 것들을 은하계가 감당하게 두겠다."

"And now," hissed the hag, "I will leave this cabin behind, and visit my beloved Vermont once more."

items.source_en:
Personal log. Heller. Argos Extractors.

I figured Kessel for your standard moon. Looks like I was... misinformed. Lin just filled me in on what we're REALLY doing here.

Looks like Lin's got another, what's the word she used? "Discreet" contract. With that Barrett guy. He says there's something special here, and he's paying top dollar for us to find it, rip it out, and deliver it, no questions asked.

I have of course been honoring this arrangement by asking Lin a ton of questions. She's playing it close to the her sweaty old vest, as usual. 

But a guy does have to wonder -- what the hell does "special" even mean in this case? We're on a moon. In the middle of nowhere.

Either this guy wants to make jewelry from some rare space diamonds, or there's some kind of ancient alien death weapon buried here.

If it's diamonds, I'm totally stealing one to give to Jennifer. Or Carlos. Or Nia. And if it's a death weapon, I get to shoot it first. Those are my terms!
items.legacy_ko:

린이 말하길, 또 무슨... 뭐라더라? "신중을 기해야 하는" 계약이라나. 그 배럿이라는 작자와 맺은 계약 말이야. 그 사람이 여기 뭔가 특별한 게 있다면서, 그걸 찾아내서 꺼내 전달하기만 하면 거액을 주겠다고 했다더군. 묻지도 따지지도 말고 말이지.

물론 난 린에게 질문 공세를 퍼부으며 이 계약을 충실히 이행하고 있지. 린은 평소처럼 땀 밴 낡은 조끼를 꽉 쥐고 입을 꾹 다물고 있지만.

그래도 궁금하긴 하잖아. 도대체 여기서 "특별한" 게 뭐냐고? 우린 지금 아무것도 없는 허허벌판 같은 달에 와 있다고.

이 사람이 희귀한 우주 다이아몬드로 보석이라도 만들고 싶은 건지, 아니면 고대의 외계 살상 무기라도 묻혀 있는 건지. 

다이아몬드라면 하나 훔쳐서 제니퍼나 카를로스, 아니면 니아한테 줘야지. 살상 무기라면 내가 먼저 쏴볼 거고. 내 조건은 그거야!

locations.vanilla_source_en:
Personal log. Heller. Argos Extractors.

I figured Vectera for your standard moon. Looks like I was... misinformed. Lin just filled me in on what we're REALLY doing here.

Looks like Lin's got another, what's the word she used? "Discreet" contract. With that Barrett guy. He says there's something special here, and he's paying top dollar for us to find it, rip it out, and deliver it, no questions asked.

I have of course been honoring this arrangement by asking Lin a ton of questions. She's playing it close to the her sweaty old vest, as usual. 

But a guy does have to wonder -- what the hell does "special" even mean in this case? We're on a moon. In the middle of nowhere.

Either this guy wants to make jewelry from some rare space diamonds, or there's some kind of ancient alien death weapon buried here.

If it's diamonds, I'm totally stealing one to give to Jennifer. Or Carlos. Or Nia. And if it's a death weapon, I get to shoot it first. Those are my terms!

-Glen Hurst

locations.vanilla_source_en:
Beginning in 2196, the Narion War - humanity's first large-scale conflict among the stars - is remembered as a defining moment for the Settled Systems. 

As the first major conflict to make extensive use of grav jump-enabled ships, the Narion War was less defined by key space battles and more by an extended, cat-and-mouse interplay between the two powers, as the well-armed and professional UC Navy tried again and again to pin down the piecemeal but savvy Freestar fleet.

Unable to strike the killing blow, the UC resorted to ever more severe tactics to try and drive the Collective to capitulate, but without success. In fact, after many long years of war with little to show for it, even the populace of the UC itself began to turn against the cause, with protests roiling even New Atlantis, the citizenry demanding the war finally come to a humane close. So, when at long last, the final blow was struck - with the UC Navy finally cornering and obliterating the Freestar fleet in 2216 -  it was a hollow victory. 

It was from the resulting negotiations - The Treaty of Narion - that the Settled Systems as we know them today emerged, both literally and figuratively. 

Despite winning the war, the UC found themselves in an unenviable position, painted as a brutal aggressor even in their home systems. So, in the spirit of unity and lasting peace, the UC agreed to the demands of the Freestar Collective and the Narion settlers whose collusion triggered the conflict in the first place, and handed over Narion to the Collective, as they had requested at the start of hostilities (including the Clinic medical starstation), creating the Freestar Collective as we know it to this day.

In return, the UC demanded two concessions: the first was payment for damages done in the form of mineral rights on multiple worlds across the galaxy. 

The second, more significant demand was that no great faction may ever colonize more than three systems. The UC would have Alpha Centauri, Sol, and Wolf, and the Freestar Collective, Cheyenne, Volii, and Narion. 

The Freestar Collective agreed to these terms, creating - and codifying into law - the Settled Systems as we know them today. The Treaty of Narion has since become the foundation of all contemporary political relations, and it's only official violation, the cause of the galaxy's greatest conflict - the Colony War.

To learn more about the Colony War, please proceed to the "Conflict Among the Stars" mural.
